app_fee.value: CAD 143.82, non-refundable (the 2027 figure in the GPS FAQ; it was CAD 139.63 for Fall 2026). One fee covers up to two programs in the same term.
app_fee.quote: The non-refundable application fee for Summer 2027 is $143.82 CAD. With one application fee, you can submit up to two applications in the same term to two different programs.

also.quote: McGill charges a non-refundable fee of $139.63 (Summer and Fall 2026) for graduate applications.

fee_waiver.value: McGill's graduate office does not waive the application fee.
fee_waiver.quote: Graduate & Postdoctoral Studies (GPS) does not offer application fee waivers.

gre_general.value: No university-wide GRE rule; each program decides, so check the program record.
gre_general.quote: Some graduate programs require GRE or GMAT results as part of the application process.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 86 overall with at least 20 in each section (old 120-point scale), or 4.5 overall on the new 6-point scale used since January 2026. Some programs ask for more.
toefl_min.quote: 120-point scale | Minimum overall score of 86 | Minimum component scores of 20 | 6-point scale (as of January 2026) | Minimum overall score of 4.5

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall; IELTS Online is not accepted. Some programs ask for more.
ielts_min.quote: A band score of 6.5 or greater (Academic module) | McGill does not accept the IELTS Online test

english_waiver.value: A degree from a university where English is the language of instruction normally exempts you, but you must send your department official proof (e.g. a letter from your university) that English was the medium of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: Has obtained (or is about to obtain) an undergraduate or graduate degree from a recognized foreign institution where English is the language of instruction | you must send documentation proving you meet one of the conditions directly to your department

also.quote: You must submit documents that corroborate you qualify (e.g. Official confirmation from your institution stating English was the primary medium of instruction.)

notes: Duolingo and PTE are not accepted for graduate admission. Many departments set higher English scores than the university minimum.
